title: clear vinyl table cloths
text: clear vinyl table cloths. This is a simple, not fancy clear vinyl table cloth.  We have a beautiful natural wood table and it is nice to be able to see the wood grain, without danger from water marks.  It is slightly reminiscent of the plastic furniture covers of the 50's... but ... my table is safe, so I am ok with it.  It's not super thick, but it is very clear - and thick enough if you're a little careful with sharp stuff.. If you want to smooth out a few of the creases you can put in your dryer on low for 3 minutes or so... put it on the table while it's warm (not hot).  There may still be a few small creases, but they smooth over time.  The edges of the table cloth are sewn with white thread.  Honestly, I came back and ordered 2 more for backups - once torn they are sort of useless as table protection... but then my sister takes them and uses them as paint protectors with her little charges.  Use and reuse!  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
